sector_model: nonfinancial (fabless analog and power semiconductors, net cash)
thesis: Monolithic Power is a debt-free power-management chip designer with 55% gross margin and 9M26 revenue +46.5% (Q3 1,202.4M, +63% year on year), driven by data center and computing demand. The business quality is strong, but at 1,190.44 the stock trades near 65x TTM GAAP earnings with a 1.0% FCF yield, so price already assumes the growth continues.
counterthesis: Valuation leaves no margin of safety: 65x earnings and ~1% FCF yield. Customer concentration: Distributor A 32% and Distributor B 16% of Q3 sales; China sales 585M in Q3 (49%) with trade-policy exposure; 91% sold through distributors. Working capital is absorbing cash (receivables +206M and inventory +200M in 9M26), so OCF (768M) lags net income (722M) less than growth would suggest but cash conversion is thinning. Stock based compensation 200M in 9M26. Stock fell about 15% from 11-03 to 11-05 (1,328.30 to 1,131.43) for a cause not established. Cyclicality and AI capex digestion are the thesis breakers.
invalidation: Revenue growth falling below about 20% with multiple still above 40x, gross margin below 52%, inventory or receivable build outpacing sales, loss of a top distributor or large customer, or export restrictions hitting China sales.
